title: Define hosted revision details
responsibility: Defines the accepted structure of a revision’s registry, comparisons, records and explanations.

outputs.name: hostedEvidenceDetail
outputs.description: A strict validation schema for a 40-character commit hash; registry availability, units, scenarios and graph; nullable comparison; optional source impact and side; verification records; explanations; and optional range-reason count. Uses the shared field limits and rejects undeclared keys. It defines structure only and performs no read by itself.
